_: The hidden showcase page, After Hours (docs/after-hours/DESIGN.md). scripts/build_after_hours.py sets tier2_desk_toy.CONFIG to this file and calls its read_desk(), so the four groups below (limits, text, formats, rules) are read and checked exactly as the tier-2 desk toy's are: `find` must exist in `file`, `show` must be part of `find`, a limit must be found once, and a miss fails the build with nothing written. Paths in those groups are relative to deskRoot; a text entry with `html: true` is read in the file's entity form. Keys beginning with `_` are comments.
_monadRoot: The optional second root (the launcher repo). Missing root: every data-ah-if="monad" region is removed and the report says so. Present root with a literal missing: exit 1.
_limits: Numbers the pieces draw with. `ast` reads a class field's default; `regex` reads the first capture group and must match exactly once in its file.

joinWindow.what: iceberg join window either side of the break

watchdog.what: watchdog loop period (anchored to the loop label; earlier timeouts are waits, not the period)

limits._vote: The desk's vote thresholds. Never printed: the generator votes the alert case's marks and conviction words with them, and 01 and 03 vote the tape with them, so the still and the live cards grade one reading the same way.

obiVote.what: OBI vote threshold (|OBI| at or past this votes)

tick.what: the instrument tick the VWAP band is measured in

_text: Words the pieces print exactly as `show`. One flat dict: a key is defined once and listed under the pieces that print it.

roNote.show: observes & displays only — never places an order

fear.find: regime = "fear" if self._sign > 0 else "inverted" if self._sign < 0 else "neutral"

_formats: The desk's own format strings: `find` must exist in `file` and is the template the generator and AH.fmt fill. {name:+.3f} formats as Python does; a spec the toy cannot format fails the build.

formats._title: The desk's title starts with {direction.capitalize()}, which is not a field the formatter fills; the literal starts after it and the capitalised direction word is prefixed by the generator and by AH.fmt.
formats._foot: The desk writes the field as {a.conviction}; the generator fills it under that name.
formats._entry: The desk's whole entry line: {span} is the gap between price and level with a trailing space, or empty at the level; {where} is the whereAbove / whereBelow / whereAt word. The generator derives both from the case; 03's script derives them from the tape.

_compose: The order pieces appear in the page (design contract 2.2), not the filename sort. Each key names parts/NN-<key>.html, styles/<key>.css and js/<key>.js.
_pieces: Which keys each piece receives in its data-ah-desk JSON ({text, fmt, lim}; 05 also bands and precedence). A piece with no entry gets the empty triple. `monad` lists the second-root literals merged into the piece's text when that root was read.
_bands: Piece 05 reads this file from deskRoot whole (utf-8-sig, `_` keys stripped): grade_bands and regime_bands verbatim as `bands`, label_precedence as `precedence`.
_alertCase: The written-out alert in 03. Word fields are text keys the generator resolves; obi, lvl and clock are synthetic values beside the toy's EXAMPLE (obi overrides EXAMPLE's, which is the tier-2 page's and stays there; 0.34 votes, so the break card can show a vote that the toy's reversal cases never needed). The generator votes the case's values under the desk's thresholds (limits obiVote, vwapTicks, tick) and derives the marks and the conviction word of each card from the fails: the break card from every value, the gap card from the toy's case 3 (VWAP and CVD absent), the ghost line from the gaps filled with 0. conviction is a tripwire: it must equal the derived break word (with obi 0.34 that is High) or the build refuses, so a desk threshold change stops the build instead of regrading the card. The entry line's gap and side come from EXAMPLE's px against lvl.
_roles: Turns a guarded file's path into a role word for 08 (longest matching prefix wins; a root-level file is its own entry). `omit` names prefixes whose guards print nowhere. An unmapped path fails the build. No word here is a path.
_families: 08's category wall: one tile per family, in this order. Every role word the `roles` map produces sits in exactly one family, and a family names no word the map does not produce; either miss refuses the build. A tile prints its generated count (the sum of its roles over every published guard less `omit`) and its role words, most guarded first, as a secondary line. `key` is the tile's handle for the live card; `label` is plain words. Grouped from the generated role counts so that no family is tiny; the build report prints each family's count.

families.label: the grader, the almanac and the options engine

_cases: 08's live card. The generator embeds `max` example cases, round-robin across the families in the order above; specific sentence first, then file order inside each; a test name staged once; never one sentence twice in a row when the family has another (the two catch-all mutation sentences go last: owner review 2026-09-29) (never a path, never find/replace text: the test name, the family, the role word and the harness's plain-words mutation). The still prints the first `examples` of them. The card plays one case every `seconds`: the broken line at 0, the test that caught it at `reveal`, the CAUGHT stamp at `stamp`; after the last case it holds `hold` seconds, then the staged pass starts again. Seconds, on the core clock; 4.8 s a case since the owner review of 2026-09-29, so CAUGHT stays up about 3 s and a long test name can be read. `skip`: patterns, case-insensitive, that a staged case's test name or mutation must not match: the broker platform's two acronyms, which name the broker in two published test names. A skipped case still counts in its family's tile (the counts are the guards, not the examples); the build refuses a composed page, or a file in the page folder, that matches a skip pattern. This file is not scanned, so the pattern can sit here.
_budget: How many pieces animate at once (body data-ah-max); the two `always` canvases are not counted.
_seed: The synthetic tape's RNG seed (body data-ah-seed). Same seed, same tape, every load.
_timings: The tier-2 stage timings in ms, read by 04 from its root's data-ah-timings.
